report-description: Export reports from results that actually exist and choose where to save them. Reports omit file paths and personal process details.
report-privacy: Reports are saved to the location you choose and are not sent online. The device scan report states when a full scan has not been performed.
report-pdf-unavailable: PDF export is unavailable; no external PDF library has been added.
settings-excluded-folders: Folders excluded from file scans and organization
settings-privacy-notice: Settings and history are stored on this device only. Disabling event history prevents new event records but does not delete existing history or the device baseline. The app does not send data online and does not store passwords or file contents.
settings-notifications-unavailable: Currently unavailable; the app does not create notifications.
settings-storage-location: Local settings and history are stored under:
settings-no-exclusions: No excluded folders have been added.
dashboard-description: An overview of tool status and available results.
do-it-for-me-description: Review a predefined task, its scope and impact, then confirm to continue to its existing tool. No arbitrary commands are run.
scan-description: Review the scan scope before inspecting this device.
investigator-description: Inspect a folder you choose to review file metadata, signatures, and hashes locally; the app does not make malware verdicts.
organizer-description: Classify files in a folder you choose and review the move plan and conflicts before confirming.
duplicates-description: Find identical files by size and SHA-256, and review old files in a folder you choose.
monitor-description: View CPU, memory, disks, and processes using the current user's permissions.
fingerprint-description: Create a local baseline of readable system, software, process, and startup information, then compare a new snapshot. Changes do not prove compromise.
timeline-description: Review events recorded by the app or manually imported from Windows logs. No earlier history exists before collection starts.
reports-description: Reports will use actual results with identified sources.
scope-detail: No device scan has been run.
results-detail: No scan results have been recorded.
activity-detail: Data will appear when a reliable source is available.
empty-title: This area is ready for implementation
empty-description: No simulated operations or results are shown. Features will appear here once implemented and verified.
notice: This build does not scan the device or change files or Windows settings.
footer: Initial dashboard — system information is read-only.
last-device-refresh-detail: When this app last read device information during the current session.
last-program-scan: Last scan performed by the app
scan-not-implemented: Reading device information is not a full system scan.
logical-processors: Logical processors available to the app
reader-partial: Device information reader is partially available
file-investigator-privacy: Inspection runs locally and only after you choose a folder; it never starts automatically. Files are never uploaded, deleted, or quarantined. This is not a malware-detection engine; type and signature indicators are informational only, and an unsigned or unknown file is not evidence of harm.
file-scan-errors: Some items could not be accessed
file-no-results: Choose a folder and start inspection to list files.
organizer-by-month: Organize by modified year and month
organizer-replace: Replace and preserve a restorable backup
organizer-safety: Nothing moves until after preview and explicit confirmation. Existing files are never replaced without explicit consent. Windows and installed application folders are excluded, and extensions alone are not treated as proof of content type.
organizer-empty-preview: Choose source and destination, then create a preview. Preview never moves files.
organizer-preview-errors: Some items could not be read
organizer-failed: The operation could not be completed
organizer-cancelled: Operation stopped; review the log for files already moved.
organizer-confirm: {0} files totaling {1} will be moved. Conflict choice: {2}. Continue?
organizer-execution-complete: Organization attempt completed; review the operation log.
organizer-interrupted-detail: Some files may have moved before cancellation. The log lists successful and failed operations.
organizer-undo-complete: Undo completed after file integrity checks.
organizer-no-undo: No move is currently safe to undo.
organizer-undo-failed: Could not safely undo the move
forgotten-duplicate-explanation: Files are bucketed by size first, then their content is compared using SHA-256. Matching names alone are not enough. Potential savings = group size minus one retained copy; your manual selection determines what is moved to the Recycle Bin.
forgotten-old-disclaimer: Modified time indicates the last recorded change to a file; it does not prove when the file was last used or opened. System and installed application folders are excluded by default.
forgotten-not-scanned: Choose a folder and analyze it to see results.
forgotten-no-duplicates: No identical files were found in the selected folder.
forgotten-no-old-files: No files exceed the selected age threshold.
forgotten-summary: Groups: {0} · Duplicate file bytes: {1} · Potential savings (keeping one copy): {2} · Selected for recycle: {3} · Old files: {4}
forgotten-progress: Files found: {0} · Hashes computed: {1} · Processed: {2} · Errors: {3}
forgotten-starting: Enumerating files and grouping by size...
forgotten-scan-complete: Analysis complete: {0} duplicate groups and {1} old files.

monitor-empty-processes: Start monitoring or refresh to list processes.
history-empty-timeline: No events recorded yet. Events are available only from when the app started collecting them.
history-empty-baseline: Create a baseline to view the collected inventory.
history-empty-changes: No changes to show. Create a baseline and compare; a change alone does not indicate compromise.
history-privacy: Data is stored locally in the app's data file. Personal file contents are not stored. Snapshots include software, process, and startup-entry names, which may contain system-specific names or paths. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
history-replace-confirm: The current baseline will be replaced with a new snapshot. Continue?
history-baseline-created: Local baseline saved: {0} items with {1} read errors.
history-comparison-complete: Comparison complete: {0} added, {1} removed, {2} changed, {3} read errors. Changes are informational, not evidence of compromise.
history-windows-imported: Imported {0} new events from the Windows System log in the last 24 hours.
history-failed: The operation failed. See the error details.
doit-intro: Choose a prepared task to review its scope and affected files or data. Confirmation here opens the existing tool; any actual change requires its own review and confirmation there.
doit-safety: This page never runs PowerShell/CMD or generated text. It only uses predefined actions in the app. It does not disable Defender or the firewall, delete system files, or upload data.
doit-plan-prompt: Choose a task to review its plan before continuing.
doit-unavailable: Unavailable — it will not be run
doit-plan-organize: Choose Downloads and a destination in the file organizer, then review every file, category path, and conflict before any move.
doit-impact-organize: Only files in the source folder and destination you choose are affected. Windows settings and system files are not changed.
doit-undo-organize: After moving, use the existing undo action; it restores only moves whose files pass SHA-256 checks.
doit-plan-large: The app has no dedicated large-file finder or size threshold. This request will not run; the file investigator displays sizes but does not automatically select large files.
doit-impact-large: No files or settings are affected; this task is currently unavailable.
doit-plan-duplicates: Choose a folder; the tool compares same-size files using local SHA-256 hashes. Scanning does not delete or move files.
doit-impact-duplicates: File metadata and contents are read to calculate hashes only within the folder you choose. Moving files to the Recycle Bin is separate and requires another confirmation.
doit-undo-duplicates: Scanning does not change files. If you separately confirm moving a file to the Recycle Bin, Windows can restore it until the user empties the bin.
doit-plan-startup: The device fingerprint page reads available Run/RunOnce entries. Creating its snapshot also includes system, installed-program, and process information.
doit-impact-startup: Startup registry keys for the user and device plus installed-program and process information are read; the snapshot is saved in the app's local history. Startup keys are not changed and data is not uploaded.
doit-undo-startup: Startup settings are not changed. The local baseline can be replaced from the device fingerprint page; reading information has no undo operation.
doit-plan-device: The existing tool refreshes Windows, processor, memory, fixed-drive, and uptime information for display.
doit-impact-device: Reads system metadata and drive capacities only; file contents are not read and no files or settings are changed.
doit-undo-readonly: Read-only action; no undo is needed.
doit-handed-off: The existing tool was opened only; this page did not run the task or change files.
doit-plan-cancelled: The plan was cancelled before continuing; no action was started.
doit-log-failed: Could not save the action log locally; the result is visible only for this session. {0}
doit-log-empty: No actions have been recorded yet.
device-info-already-refreshing: Device information is already being refreshed.
